function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Investigate the HyperFund and HyperVerse alleged cryptocurrency fraud network comprehensively, using only evidence available through October 1, 2026 and returning source IDs for every material statement. Prioritize direct and authoritative evidence such as government complaints, indictments, judgments, regulator warnings, court filings, official company materials archived or quoted in reliable records, and reputable investigative reporting where primary records are unavailable. Establish a dated chronology and distinguish proven facts, allegations, assessments, and uncertainty. Specifically research: (1) the alleged business and financial mechanics, including membership or package purchases, cryptocurrency deposits, promised returns, yield or mining claims, payment schedules, withdrawal restrictions, recruitment/referral commissions, pyramid or Ponzi allegations, and any related entities or platforms; (2) public promoters, influencers, representatives, celebrities, speakers, or affiliated entities who marketed or endorsed it, with what each publicly said or did and how that could have aided recruitment, without implying liability unless supported; (3) the transition or rebranding from HyperFund to HyperVerse and any use of HyperNation, HyperCommunity, HyperCapital, HyperTech, HyperOne, or other related names, websites, platforms, corporate identities, and stated or alleged reasons; (4) the purported chief executive or senior leader, especially Sam Lee and any other relevant person, including identity, biography, credentials, public appearances, organizational role, and evidence of disputed or questionable persona; (5) how credibility, promotion, solicitation, payment flows, and network persistence interacted; and (6) explicit contradictions among sources, unresolved identity/entity issues, and limits of what can be concluded. For each source, provide a stable source ID, title, issuing organization or author, date, link if available, and exact relevant passage or a faithful clearly marked summary. Do not infer unsupported facts, do not collapse allegations into findings, and do not cite sources that were not actually returned by the tool."}
function.name: ConductResearch
